driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard car behavior targeting M1/car discharge headway (target 0.3467s). Reduced tau from 1.5 to 1.4 to slightly decrease gap acceptance time and improve flow, while maintaining compliance.
Highly impatient car archetype targeting M2/early/car share (target ~0.011). High lcImpatience drives creep into the green window.
Standard motorcycle behavior targeting M1/moto discharge headway (target 0.2957s). Reduced minGap from 2.0 to 1.8 to improve flow while keeping lateral center position.

Slow motorcycle archetype targeting M4/lat_moto (lateral position) and M4/overshoot_share. Lower speedFactor keeps them in lane center longer. Increased tau prevents excessive overtaking of slow cars.

Violating motorcycle archetype (custom1) targeting M6/approach/l/moto entry timing and M8/moto wrong-lane share. High lcSublane pushes vehicle into adjacent lanes (wrong lane) to mimic illegal left-turn behavior from HDT_N/S.

traci_rules.rationale: Moderate early start creep window and probability for cars to match M2/early/car share (target ~0.011). Reduced p from previous iterations to avoid overshooting the low observed mean.

Enables red-light running for standard motorcycles to match M3/share/moto (target ~0.098) and M3/per_cycle (target ~3.913). Increased p0 to boost base probability closer to observation, using swarm effect k.
Adds extra hold time for illegal left-turning motorcycles to match M6/approach/l/moto entry timing (target ~53.58s) and reduce excessive holding times seen in previous iterations.

description: Adjusted archetype shares, lateral parameters, and rule probabilities to reduce red-light running rates, correct early-start share for cars, and enable lane encroachment for violating motorcycles while maintaining realistic discharge headways.
